texts.preamble: Himangshu Sarma vs The State Of Assam And 4 Ors on 11 March, 2025 Page No.# 1/2 Gahc010036402024 The Gauhati High Court (High Court Of Assam, Nagaland, Mizoram And Arunachal Pradesh) Case No. : Wp(C)/929/2024 Himangshu Sarma S/O Sri Tarun Sarma, Resident Of Keotpara, Po Janaram Chowka, Assam, 784529. Versus The State Of Assam And 4 Ors Represented By The Commissioner And Secretary To The Govt. Of Assam, Health And Family Welfare Department, Dispur, Guwahati 06 2:The Additional Chief Secretary To The Govt. Of Assam Health And Family Welfare Department Dispur Guwahati 06 3:The Joint Secretary To The Govt. Of Assam Health And Family Welfare Department Dispur Guwahati 06 4:The Selection Sub Committee Represented By Its Chairperson Commissioner Food Safety And Drugs Control Administration Assam Dispur Guwahati 06 5:Sri Himangshu Pratim Nath Resident Of Village Barbhagia Page N Po Charaibahi Himangshu Sarma vs The State Of Assam And 4 Ors on 11 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/10582929/ 1 Dist Morigaon Assam 78210 Advocate for the Petitioner : Mr. A J Das, Mr P Deka,Mr G Rengma Advocate for the Respondent : Ga, Assam, Sc, Health Before Joint Registrar (Judl.) Mr. Chinmoy Baruah Order Date : 11.03.2025 Case taken up before the Lawazima Court.
texts.facts: None appears on behalf of the petitioner. Perusal of the office note dated 18.03.2025 reveals that notice was issued to the respondent No. 5 by registered post with A/D on 16.03.2024. However, in regard to the notice issued to the respondent No. 5, it appears that the said notice has been received un-served with the following postal remark "Not found Return to sender". Perusal of the instant case record reveals that the earlier Lawazima Court vide its order dated 11.03.2025 had granted 7 (seven) days time to obtain necessary instructions regarding the address of respondent No. 5. Thereafter, it has been observed that the instant matter was listed again before the Lawazima Court on 27.05.2025 and the said Lawazima Court was pleased to grant the petitioner one last chance to take necessary steps for obtaining instructions regarding the address of respondent No. 5. However, no one has appeared on behalf of the petitioner before the Lawazima Court today to make submission regarding the address of the respondent mentioned above. In view of the observations made above, it may be discerned that the petitioner may not be interested to pursue the case.
